page.overview:
What is Ace Magic Wand Factory?

The Ace Magic Wand Factory is a location in the The Adventures of Super Mario Bros. 3 episode "A Toadally Magical Adventure."

The Ace Magic Wand Factory is a factory that produces Magic Wands. It is located in the Sky World.
